questions: Where do you usually buy your food?
Do you write a shopping list?
How often do you shop for food?
Do you look at the price first or the quality?
Have you ever bought food online?

teaching.tense_focus: present simple with frequency adverbs, plus present perfect on the last question
teaching.band_move: Keep food nouns uncountable. 'Foods', 'breads' and 'rices' will cost you across this whole frame.

questions.answer_shape: Name the place, say why there, then name what you buy elsewhere.
questions.extend_move: The supermarket for most of it, and the Turkish shop on the corner for anything fresh.

common_error.wrong: I buy my foods in the supermarket.
common_error.right: I buy my food at the supermarket.
common_error.why: 'Food' has no plural, and you shop 'at' a place.

questions.answer_shape: Say whether you do, say what happens when you don't, then how strictly you follow it.
questions.extend_move: Always — and I still come home with three things that weren't on it.

common_error.wrong: I write always a list before shopping.
common_error.right: I always write a list before I go.
common_error.why: Frequency adverbs sit before the main verb.

questions.probe: On paper or on your phone?

questions.answer_shape: Give the frequency, say what decides it, then what you buy in between.
questions.extend_move: A big shop once a week, then two or three small ones for bread and milk.

common_error.wrong: I go shopping two times in a week.
common_error.right: I go shopping twice a week.
common_error.why: 'Twice a week' is the natural form; 'in' is wrong here.

questions.probe: Who does it in your house?

questions.answer_shape: Pick one, say which foods you make an exception for, then why.
questions.extend_move: Price for most things, quality for anything I'm going to taste on its own.

common_error.right: I look at the price first.

questions.answer_shape: Say whether you have, name when, then whether you'd do it again.
questions.extend_move: I have, during the winter, and half the fruit arrived in a state I wouldn't have chosen.

common_error.wrong: Yes, I buy food online last year.
common_error.right: Yes, I bought food online last year.
common_error.why: A finished time phrase pulls you into past simple.
